title: Better words, a weaker point
chapter: Can’t See the Forest for the Trees
lines: An AI improved the author’s sentences, and quietly weakened what he was trying to say.
That experience opens Can't See the Forest for the Trees, a book about systems that miss the damage they cause.

title: When smoothing conceals tension
chapter: An edit can lose the argument
lines: The sentences sounded reasonable while doubt, urgency, and responsibility became easier to overlook.
The book follows a similar pattern in companies, research, politics, and the technologies connecting them.

voiceDirections: Speak with quiet unease; give gentle emphasis to responsibility. Keep a natural conversational voice, let the listener picture this specific situation, and leave a real pause at the end.
